convert_dpt_checkpoint: convert a DINOv2 DPT depth estimation checkpoint to HuggingFace DPT format and save to disk
get_dpt_config: get a DPT configuration for a DINOv2 model variant with appropriate neck hidden sizes and backbone settings
create_rename_keys_dpt: create a mapping of DPT head state dict key renames from original DINOv2 to HuggingFace DPT naming
create_rename_keys_backbone: create a mapping of backbone state dict key renames from original DINOv2 to HuggingFace DPT naming
read_in_q_k_v: split combined QKV attention matrices into separate query, key, and value weight tensors per encoder layer
